Ley Portals can be found across Azsuna in the Broken Isles. Most of them are linked together in pairs, allowing players to reach areas that wouldn't otherwise be accessible without flying. There are two that simply teleport the player down from a building to the ground, possibly meant for avoiding fall damage.
The Lifeblood Crystal is left behind after defeating a Treasure Wraith during delves. They can be interacted with, in order to obtain the Essence of Life (delve power) power.

The Lightforged are mortal beings infused with the Holy Light and transformed into immortal protectors of creation. They stand as a beacon of hope against the darkness and embody the Light's wrath. In the main universe, they form the ranks of the Grand Army of the Light, while their counterparts on became known as the Lightbound. Although the majority are draenei, other races have also shown the potential to become Lightforged. The transformation can also be forcibly imposed, as demonstrated by Xe'ra's attempt to transform Illidan Stormrage against his will. While most known Lightforged are intelligent mortals, other creatures have also been imbued with the Light, including talbuk and elekk

Lord Vileor is an Acolyte and boss of the Cult of the Damned in the Human prologue campaign of . In the Homecoming chapter of Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom, he is among the cultists who ambush the city guards in the throne room of Capital City.

. From left to right: Eric, Olaf, Baelog.]] The Lost Dwarves (referred to at one point as Lost Vikings) are a trio of adventurous dwarven viking brothers: Baelog, Eric "The Swift", and Olaf. Ever hungry for fame and (more importantly) riches, the brothers have been involved in several adventures over the years, mostly in or near Uldaman and the Badlands. Each of the dwarves specializes in different skills in battle: Eric favors speed, Baelog combat, and Olaf defense. The brothers own a magical, flying dwarven longboat.
Lost Legion Darkglares are darkglares that can be found flying above the Broken Isles. Flying into them will cause them to die and spawn several Residual Time Motes.
Lost Legion Felbat are bats that can be found flying above the Broken Isles. Flying into them will cause them to die and spawn several Residual Time Motes.

Lovely Revelers are orcs and Mag'har orcs located in Orgrimmar, Forsaken feasting on a Fresh Corpse in the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity, and humans located in Stormwind City. Some of the humans are Kul Tirans. Those with the Strongly Scented buff are disguised Crown Alchemists and sometimes Strange Winged Goblins.

Lounge Waitstaffs are blood elves located at the Walk of Elders and between the Royal Exchange and Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City.

Ludwin is a black whelp located in the Celestial Vault in the Shrine of Seven Stars and the Jade Vaults in the Shrine of Two Moons during Pandaria Remix, and the Bank of Dalaran and Dalaran Merchant's Bank during Legion Remix.

Lutokk is a dead tuskarr located in Brackenhide Brambles in the Azure Span who was supposed to get married. He went with his fellow tuskarr to a hunt, but was killed by the Brackenhide gnolls. When the adventurer found his body and called upon his spirit, instead of crossing over Lutokk resolved to empower Brena's Totem to fight against the decay-corrupted gnolls. Brena then summoned him to help destroy the Twisted Ancient, after which Brena thanked him and released all the spirits to be with Karkut.

Man'ye was the son and heir of the great Amani warlord Zul'jin. One of the most talented shaman of his age, Man'ye was chosen by his father and Hex Lord Malacrass to embody the royal loa, Akil'zon, in defending the great city of Atal'Aman. Taking up this charge, Man'ye was infused with the power of the Loa, but was eventually felled in battle shortly before his father. With the death of Zul'jin and his heir, the Amani were plunged into a succession crisis, as Man'ye's own children were too young to rule.

While in the raid, players will automatically be offered the quest in the vicinity of Fractillus. Zo'turu offers it outside the raid as a backup.

Miner Jareeth is a draenei working as a miner in Outland. He and Miner Landani were transporting a Netherstorm draeneite shipment to Shattrath City to be delivered to the crystalsmiths in the Lower City when their cargo went haywire near Cenarion Thicket and knocked crates off their wagon which caused them to run late. They were able to deliver the shipment after getting aid from a draenei adventurer who had been sent by Apprentice Beruun to check on them. Later, he and Landani were present in the Exodar during the Tishamaat.

Miner Landani is a draenei working as a miner in Outland. She and Miner Jareeth were transporting a Netherstorm draeneite shipment to Shattrath City to be delivered to the crystalsmiths in the Lower City when their cargo went haywire near Cenarion Thicket and knocked crates off their wagon which caused them to run late. They were able to deliver the shipment after getting aid from a draenei adventurer who had been sent by Apprentice Beruun to check on them. Later, she and Jareeth were present in the Exodar during the Tishamaat.

Millennia's Threshold is one of many platforms in the Timeways found in the Dawn of the Infinite megadungeon, containing a portal to the Bronze Temple. When the infinite dragonflight infiltrated the area, Nozdormu, Chromie, and adventurers arrived on the platform. Nozdormu stabilized its portals, while adventurers defeated time anomalies. Afterward, they fought Manifested Timeways. After it was defeated, the pathway to the rest of the Timeways was opened. When the infinite dragonflight rewrote the true timeline, the infinites took the platform until Chromie and adventurers returned and defeated them. It is also used to travel Azeroth and beyond to seasonal dungeons as part of the current PvE
Miniature Shards of Amorphous Relic is a power obtained by looting a Curio Container in delves. Its powers are based on the Amorphous Relic.
Mind Shatter is an ability card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.

Mischievous Presents can be summoned by players under the effects of Jubilant Snowman Costume. They look similar to the Portentous Present. Once summoned, they roam around the area at random before usually stopping to create a Snow Mound on the ground, which they then run in circles around a few times before despawning. Occasionally, they will also spit snowballs at distant targets. Hitting a Mischievous Present with the Jubilant Snowman Costume's Throw Snowball ability will briefly knock it over and stun it. (Hitting it with a regular Snowball item has no effect.)
Minions of Terokk are kaliri that spawn at the Lower City in Shattrath City during The Skettis Offensive.

The Mischevious Chick is a dragonhawk located next to the Rookery Cache at the Sunwing Rookery in Silvermoon City. It has stolen the Rookery Cache Key but can be convinced to part with it, by placing a plate of Tasty Meat in front of the chick.

The Misty Vale is an area located in Thaldraszus. The entrance to the Emberslate Cavern is found here. A largely uninhabited area adjacent to Valdrakken, it was utilized as a hideout by Primalist-aligned rebel drakonid of the Flightless as they conducted a campaign of low-level sabotage against the Valdrakken Accord. Investigator Erima was assigned to root them out. She did so with the help of Horde and Alliance adventurers by eliminating the rebels and Primalists, collecting their maps, and destroying caches of incendiary runestones. As Erima was scouting the camp, he noticed his old friend, Maldra Flametongue, held captive by Orian Darkwater. After killing him, Maldra reunited with Erima.

Queen Modgud Thaurissan was the sorceress wife of Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan during the War of the Three Hammers. She led the Dark Iron clan's assault on Grim Batol, where she was killed by Khardros Wildhammer. Upon her death, she cursed the city with dark magic, rendering it uninhabitable.

Neldris is a black drakonid located in the Onyx Laboratory in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible. She is one of The Forgotten Experiments, created by Neltharion 20,000 years ago in his attempts to create ideal soldiers for the War of the Scaleborn. Neldris closely resembles an ordinary drakonid aside from some exposed flesh and an arcane glow, and primarily fights with physical attacks. Still, she was deemed unsatisfactory for lacking the "desired strength". However, she was also deemed too dangerous to destroy, and was sealed in stasis until being released by the Echo of Neltharion to test several intruders.

No Harm Ever Came From Reading A Book is an exploration achievement earned by returning the evil copies of yourself back to the book after following the spiders in Pillar-nest Xesh in southern Azj-Kahet. To begin, enter the cave of Pillar-nest Xesh at and navigate to the western end of the cave. Three untargetable spiders on the wall show the path to jump up the wall and into the hole in the back. This involves some precise jumping, especially for shorter races like gnomes and goblins. Once in the lower layer, interact with the Fleshy Grimoire at in City of Threads coordinates or in Azj-Kahet coordinates. This causes four Another You images to briefly appear: : : : Use the Mysterious Portal

Nomurok is a dead tuskarr located in Brackenhide Brambles in the Azure Span. Being a young tuskarr, he went with his fellow tuskarr to his first hunt, but was killed by the Brackenhide gnolls. When the adventurer found his body and called upon his spirit, instead of crossing over Nomurok resolved to empower Brena's Totem to fight against the decay-corrupted gnolls. Brena then summoned him to help destroy the Twisted Ancient, after which Brena thanked him and released all the spirits to be with Karkut.

North Sufaad , or Sufaad, is a section of city ruins located in the Merciless Wastes, east of the Lunnall River and south of the Oasis. It is under the control of the Sufaadi Wastelanders. It was once one of the largest city-states of K'aresh.

Ny'alotha, the Waking City sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 8.3.0 and Ny'alotha, the Waking City, the final raid of . They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Ny'alotha appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 25. Completing one of these sets will grant the All Eyes On Me achievement.
